department: Department of Electrical, Computer & Energy Engineering

deadline.value: International PhD applications are due December 10 at 10pm MST (domestic December 15); year inferred for the 2026-27 cycle.

fee_waiver.value: ECEE has no fee waivers for international applicants.
fee_waiver.quote: We do not have fee waivers available for international applicants.

gre_general.value: The GRE is not part of the review.
gre_general.quote: The GRE is not required for our application process. Submitting these scores does not have any added benefit as the GRE is not part of the review process.

supervisor.value: No need to secure an advisor or funding before applying.
supervisor.quote: Applicants do not need to apply separately for funding or secure funding/an advisor in advance of applying.

funding.value: Admitted PhD students are offered Research Assistantships with five years of funding, unless they have other means.
funding.quote: Our admitted PhD students are offered Research Assistantships with five years of funding, unless the applicant has other stated means

entry_route.value: Minimum eligibility is a 3.0 GPA from an accredited BS STEM program; no master's needed.
entry_route.quote: Our minimum eligibility requirement to apply to either the PhD or MS programs is a GPA of 3.0 of higher from an accredited Bachelor of Science (BS) STEM program

gre_subject.value: Not stated on the pages checked

notes: Dept PhD page applies the College of Engineering and Applied Science.
